caption_L1: Here a area graph is called Slovakia : Unemployment rate from 1999 to 2020. The x-axis measures Year. Unemployment rate is drawn along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Between 1999 and 2020, unemployment rates have fluctuated between 0.05 and 0.20. The highest rates were around 2002. Between 2004 and 2008, there was a steady decrease in unemployment, but this then increased significantly between 2008 and 2010 (although not to the high rates seen pre-2006). Since 2013, there has been another steady decrease in unemployment in Slovakia up to 2020, where rates are at the lowest they have been for over 20 years.
